question: What is the total amount of liabilities owed by the U.S. Treasury to the United Kingdom in CY1986 in billions of dollars rounded to the nearest hundredths place?
raw_response:
I can clearly see the table now. The column headers under "Calendar year" are 1985, 1986, 1987r, then 1988 months (May, June, July, Aug.p, Sept.p).

The United Kingdom row: 1985=79,757 | **1986=90,833** | 1987r=126,446 | May=124,327 | June=123,943 | July=130,316 | Aug.p=131,041 | Sept.p=121,396.

So the CY1986 liabilities to the United Kingdom = 90,833 million dollars = 90.833 billion = **90.83** billion rounded to the nearest hundredth.

The values are all integers (no decimal point in the source value of millions), but the answer in billions requires conversion: 90,833 / 1000 = 90.833 → 90.83. This produces a decimal answer, so MODE A delimiter applies (single value, no delimiter needed anyway).

<FINAL_ANSWER>90.83</FINAL_ANSWER>
